status: Exploratory protocol fixed before this sweep; not preregistered or held out
mounting: Rigid and centred on body axis; height is axle-to-payload COM distance along body. No load changes during a run.
zero_mass_policy: One zero-payload configuration at nominal 0.18 m; duplicates at other heights omitted
force_policy: Horizontal force acts at the combined loaded-body COM, as in the original model. Its moment arm varies with loading; this is not a fixed attachment-point test.
gain_policy: Frozen original gains, integral clamp, saturation and filter process covariance; no tuning or adaptation
seed_formula: 1001 + 104729 * i, i=0..29; paired across loads, controllers and sensing profiles
primary_outcome: Fall by 10 s at control endpoints, absolute true tilt >=45 deg
recovery: Original final continuous one-second dwell: absolute tilt <=1 deg, position <=0.03 m and speed <=0.03 m/s; measured after pulse end, or t=0 if force=0
secondary_metrics: Peak tilt, displacement, saturation duration, squared torque integral, final-one-second RMS tilt/position/speed for full-duration trials only
statistics: Wilson 95% intervals only for noisy fixed-condition fall fractions; deterministic outcomes are not random samples. No pooled operational success probabilities or controller-class claims.
numerical_audit: Repeat all 2016 deterministic trials with two RK4 substeps while keeping 200 Hz control. Repeat any changed outcomes with four substeps.
